method.filtering_summary: The live search pulled 2,295 postings; 1,680 were older than 7 days, 0 were reposts of listings over 30 days old, 247 were senior or excluded titles, 144 were not target roles, 148 failed Kenya eligibility, 10 were already applied to and 18 were duplicates. Himalayas failed with an IncompleteRead error and ReliefWeb failed with a parse error. A signed-in browser pass of Wellfound at about 7:44 AM EAT (remote-only, Worldwide; Wellfound hides jobs that are not Nairobi-eligible) pulled about 85 roles and kept 1 (Yara, Full Stack Engineer (New Grad)). Examples left out: Veilky (5+ years), GenX intern (unpaid, Germany students only), Lupira PERN intern (unpaid or unclear pay), and SeeClear (a task gig via micro1). Fuzu was checked in the signed-in browser (about 482 Kenya roles pulled, 7 kept). The MyJobMag personalised feed was checked in the signed-in browser (about 25 pulled, 4 kept). Canonical's new Graduate Software Engineer post is open worldwide on Greenhouse (first published 16 November). It is shown today under a one-day exemption from the company-and-title filter because the Greenhouse URL is new; it may be a repost of the graduate role that turned him down on 14 October. The micro1 portal lists three fitting engineering roles (Software Engineer - Backend, Software Engineer, ML Engineer), also shown today under a one-day exemption because the posting URLs are new; its Machine Learning Researcher, Applied Scientists and AI Agent Tester posts were dropped as research or non-engineering roles. Roles skipped by Ben's standing decisions (SoSafe, FlexiSAF, micro1 AI Safety, Ideactra, Nestify, Cursor, KDCI, Cellulant, SHMETER, Tana, Share, Scanwick, Heather) were left out. Most other Jobgether leads were Europe, UAE, Israel or South Africa only and mid-level (2-5 years). The remote shortlist is shorter than the usual 6-10 because few fresh, junior-to-mid roles both stayed open, clearly included Kenya, and had not already been shown. The Hiring market news group is left out: nothing verified was published in the last 48 hours. Feed roles that are not already in the Kenya jobs or the applied log are listed under From your feeds.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (New Grad)
jobs.location_as_stated: "Onsite or remote"; "Hires remotely in Everywhere"; job location New York City and San Francisco (Wellfound)
jobs.experience_asked: No years required. Wellfound says it is for people graduating this year or who finished within the last 18 months. A CS degree, a bootcamp with real projects, or a body of work is accepted; it asks for working TypeScript, Python or Go, something deployed and maintained, and LLM-powered side projects that go past a chat wrapper (tool-calling, agents, evals). Visa sponsorship is not available.
jobs.verified: Wellfound posting opened via signed-in browser pass and r.jina.ai reader, live 2026-11-18; Wellfound showed "Posted: 1 day ago" (wellfound.com returns 403 to curl)
jobs.fit: A remote-everywhere, full-time new-grad full-stack role with TypeScript or Python and LLM or agent side projects, which matches his CS degree (August 2026, within the 18-month window) and his stack. Salary is shown.
jobs.gaps: This is a Yara Network application: one application is matched across partner companies, not a role at Yara itself. Visa sponsorship is not available. It is listed as onsite or remote in New York City and San Francisco, while also hiring remotely Everywhere. Interviews may include a one- or two-day work trial.

stories.title: Vercel releases eve 1.0, an open-source framework for production agents
stories.summary: On 17 November Vercel announced eve 1.0 as generally available after a June public preview, with 230+ releases since, approval controls for agent actions, and an open-source Workflow SDK that lets an agent resume from its last completed step after a crash.
stories.why: He builds agent and automation workflows, and durable execution plus approval controls are the production concerns he runs into.

stories.title: Microsoft launches Copilot SDK 2.0 for building agents
stories.summary: On 17 November, at Ignite, Microsoft announced the Microsoft Copilot SDK (previously the GitHub Copilot SDK), with a runtime that hosts many isolated sessions in one process, available in TypeScript, Python, Go, .NET, Java and Rust.
stories.why: A TypeScript and Python SDK for building agents is directly usable with his stack.

stories.title: Replit launches Missions, coordinated agent swarms for large goals
stories.summary: On 17 November Replit said Missions lets a team define an outcome and budget while a swarm of agents plans, builds, tests and iterates; Replit says it built an in-house monitoring platform in 2 days within a $3,000 budget.
stories.why: It shows where agentic coding tools are heading, and Replit states the budget and boundaries are set by the user.

stories.title: MBZUAI releases six fully open K2-Horizon models from 0.9B to 375B
stories.summary: On 17 November AI Weekly reported that MBZUAI released K2-Horizon, six models from a 0.9B dense network to a 375B-A23B mixture-of-experts flagship, with intermediate checkpoints and data pipelines; the 375B and 36B models currently ship weights only.
stories.why: Small open-weight models in GGUF and MLX formats are easy to run locally for the kind of LLM prototyping on his CV.

stories.title: PROTEGEY raises pre-seed for a shared fraud intelligence network across Africa
stories.summary: On 17 November African-Startups reported that PROTEGEY raised pre-seed funding from LvlUp Ventures and angel investors; it did not disclose the amount, valuation or first markets.
stories.why: An early-stage African fintech building AI-based fraud and compliance tooling is the kind of company that hires API and integration engineers.

stories.title: Sudanese fintech Cashi raises $660k from Proparco
stories.summary: On 17 November Disrupt Africa reported that Cashi raised US$660,000 from Proparco, its first investment in Sudan; the MyCashi wallet has 2.2 million registered users.
stories.why: Another African payments company building around cash-heavy markets, which is context for fintech work.

stories.title: Nigeria-based Khaime raises $500,000 pre-seed for AI-agent commerce
stories.summary: On 17 November Launch Base Africa listed Khaime among its deals: a $500,000 pre-seed led by Launch Africa Ventures for an agent-first commerce platform with an AI agent that handles chats and turns conversations into orders.
stories.why: A funded African startup built around AI agents and chat channels such as WhatsApp, close to his automation work.

stories.title: Payaza gets CBK authorisation to operate as a payment service provider in Kenya
stories.summary: On 17 November Tuko reported that Payaza received Central Bank of Kenya authorisation as a payment service provider; the Nairametrics report says it covers gateway services such as card, mobile money and bank payments but not wallets or holding customer funds.
stories.why: A new licensed payment gateway entering Kenya adds competition and possibly integration work in the payments space he knows.

stories.title: Kenya's payments rules are under review as new providers enter
stories.summary: On 17 November The Standard Business, via The Online Kenyan, reported that M-PESA processed 46.41 billion transactions worth Sh41.68 trillion in the year to March 2026 and that the draft National Payment System Bill, 2026 aims to promote interoperability, competition and consumer protection.
stories.why: The proposed bill could change licensing for the payment providers he may work for or integrate with.
